g.text: New records are Task products. JSON reloads produce
plain records with the same persisted fields.
TodoService only requires the load/save shape.
Domain and controller know nothing about IdeaBox.
Same service surface, through structural typing.
Add operations log first; other members delegate.
Logging is composed outside the domain service.
load(): read first member (active task list).
save(tasks): forward to every member in order.
Archive keeps the first-saved record per ID.
Cancel: never call the real delete operation.
OK: delegate through decorator to TodoService.
Confirmation stays outside domain rules and rendering.
Subject saves, then notifies after store/toggle/delete.
Initial count is set by main.js after subscription.
Wrappers do not need a subscribe() method.
Only successful normal Add/Enter commands are kept.
Pop occurs before Undo: Cancel keeps the task but
consumes that entry, as in the supplied lab.
History is in memory and resets on reload.
creates; subscribes on raw service; initializes
runs normal Add / Enter; Undo button
